significance: The fourth of the six war-camp abodes of Murugan, built on a sixty-foot mound reached by a long stair, with three gopurams and three enclosures and shrines to Sundareswarar and Meenakshi at the foot of the hill.
story: Here the child Murugan is said to have expounded the meaning of the syllable Om to his father Shiva, and so earned the name Swaminatha, teacher of the lord.
